services.desc: Duration 2 to 8 Hours About Rent a Luxury Pontoon, our most popular rental with all the advanced features you could want in a boat! Pontoon Boat Rental includes: ● 150 horsepower Yamaha engine ● Easy-to-operate vessel ● Roomy, comfortable seating for up to 12 people ● Life jackets for adults, juniors, and infants ● 9 ft Sunbrella for shade ● Anchors for fishing or a picnic on Bull Creek ● Garmin GPS navigation charts and sonar depth finder ● Fusion stereo and speakers with bluetooth capability ● All United States Coast Guard-required
